small_guidance:
- The fused activation+bias kernel is already memory-bound and runs fast; the Conv3d dominates at ~9ms. Tuning BLOCK_SIZE/num_warps on this tail kernel (try BLOCK_SIZE=4096, num_warps=8, num_stages=2) will gain at most a few percent.
- Consider folding bias add into the conv epilogue once a custom conv kernel exists; do not keep a standalone elementwise pass.
- Verify channels_last_3d layout on the conv output to ensure coalesced channel-broadcast bias load.
large_guidance:
- Replace nn.Conv3d with a custom Triton kernel: implement as an implicit-GEMM (im2col-style), one program per (N, OC tile, output-spatial tile), with GEMM-K = IC*KD*KH*KW = 8*27 = 216. Use BLOCK_M=64, BLOCK_N=64, BLOCK_K=32, num_warps=4, num_stages=2 as a safe starting config; autotune over {(32,32,16),(64,32,16),(64,64,32)}.
- Fuse the full activation chain (ReLU → LeakyReLU → GELU → Sigmoid → bias-add) into the conv epilogue on the accumulator before store, eliminating the separate elementwise kernel and its full read/write of the 64*32*30*62*62 output tensor (~915MB traffic).
- Use channels_last_3d (NDHWC) input/output layout so the IC dimension is contiguous along GEMM-K, enabling coalesced loads in the im2col gather. Hoist all stride/padding index math out of the K-loop.
